heading: This Afternoon
text: Mostly sunny. Highs from the mid 50s to around 60. South to southwest winds 5 to 10 mph, gusting to 20 mph in the Champlain and St. Lawrence valleys.

heading: Tonight
text: Clear to partly cloudy. Lows in the upper 20s to lower 30s, except mid to upper 30s in the Champlain and St. Lawrence valleys. Winds becoming light and variable, except south 5 to 10 mph in the Champlain and St. Lawrence valleys.

heading: Thursday
text: Partly to mostly sunny. Highs in the mid to upper 50s. Winds variable to southwest at around 5 mph east of the Greens, from the south to southwest 5 to 10 mph in areas west of the Greens, except gusting to 20 mph in the St. Lawrence valley.
